name: ever-gauzy
description: Ever® Gauzy™ - Open Business Management Platform (ERP/CRM/HRM/ATS/PM) - https://gauzy.co
one_liner: A free, all-in-one business software suite covering customer relationships, HR, project management, and hiring, that a small business can run itself instead of paying for five separate subscriptions.
buyer: A small business owner (a restaurant, agency, or trades business) paying for multiple SaaS tools who wants to consolidate and cut costs.
business_use_cases: A small agency replaces separate CRM, HR, and project-management subscriptions with one self-hosted system, cutting its monthly software spend.
A local restaurant chain uses its inventory and HR/ATS modules to manage staff scheduling and stock instead of a paid restaurant-management SaaS.
An MSP offers 'we host and customize your business software' as a service to small businesses that don't want to run servers themselves.

money_ideas.idea: Offer white-glove setup, customization, and migration-from-other-SaaS services for small businesses
Run a managed-hosting version and charge a monthly fee per company

steal_this: This weekend, deploy it for one real small business currently paying for three or more separate SaaS tools, migrate their data, and charge a flat setup fee plus a small monthly hosting fee.
